dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: Welcome to the land of the Masters of the Night-Wind. I am the tribal chief, Biram.

dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: Most people who visit come with questions they'd like answered, but I tend to leave them stewing a while longer before they ask.

dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: Exploring secrets and revealing fortunes leads to results of a sort, and these results are exactly what the relevant prophecies reveal.

dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: As such, those apt to know secrets bear additional responsibility by nature.

dialogues.speaker: Biram
dialogues.text: Frankly speaking, people who keep secrets are more likely to be healthy and live longer. That's one of the universal laws of nature.
